requirements.requirement: Remove ability to edit Start Date and End Date fields
Auto-determine period dates based on selected Period Date
Auto-generate period name in format "2025 Янв" during creation
Make period name non-editable during editing

step.title: Add helper functions for auto-generation
Add reactive statement for auto-generating period name

change.description: Update period name field to be readonly during editing
Remove start and end date fields completely
change.to:
{#if formData.date} {@const { start, end } = generateDateRange(formData.date)}

Период будет установлен автоматически:
С {start.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')} по {end.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')}

{/if}

test.title: Test auto-generation of period name
test.steps: 1. Click "Добавить период" 2. Select date "2025-01" 3. Verify period name auto-fills with "2025 Янв" 4. Change to "2025-12" 5. Verify period name updates to "2025 Дек"

test.title: Test date range auto-generation
test.steps: 1. Select date "2025-02" 2. Verify info box shows "С 01.02.2025 по 28.02.2025" 3. Select date "2024-02" (leap year) 4. Verify info box shows "С 01.02.2024 по 29.02.2024"

test.title: Test editing existing period
test.steps: 1. Click edit on existing period 2. Verify period name field is readonly 3. Verify period name shows existing value 4. Verify no start/end date fields present 5. Change period date 6. Submit and verify original name is preserved

test.title: Test form submission
test.steps: 1. Create new period with date "2025-03" 2. Submit form 3. Verify API receives: - ru_name: "2025 Мар" - start_date: "2025-03-01T00:00:00.000Z" - end_date: "2025-03-31T00:00:00.000Z"

test.title: Test period name preservation on edit
test.steps: 1. Edit period with custom name "Особый период" 2. Change date to different month 3. Submit 4. Verify name remains "Особый период"
